ns2:section.sectionText: 4 hours. Topic: Multiphase Computational Fluid Dynamics. Course will concentrate on governing equations and numerical solution of multiphase equations in both Eulerian and Lagrangian reference frames. This includes a review of theoretical and empirical point-force expressions for an individual particle surface force. In addition, resolved-surface techniques, such as immersed-boundary methods and level-set methods will be employed. Prerequisite: Introductory Multiphase course such as CEE 559 Sediment Transport, AE 513: Dispersed Multiphase Flow, or ME 504 Multiphase Systems and Processes.
